blocks.text:
**Group departure: 5–16 February 2027**

Carnival is woven into a larger itinerary rather than standing apart from the rest of the trip. By day, Rio unfolds through its ocean, mountains and historic districts; by night, the Sambadrome fills with samba schools, drummers and spectacular moving floats. After the celebrations, the setting changes dramatically: the subtropical rainforest of Misiones and the cascades of Iguazu replace the city.

The final part of the journey offers several free days in Búzios. With more than 20 beaches on the peninsula, you can choose between sheltered bays, exposed stretches of surf, boat trips and buggy rides. This sequence combines a major cultural event, sightseeing and a proper seaside break.

The trip is designed so that each stage offers a different experience. In Rio, highlights include panoramic viewpoints, beaches and Carnival. At Iguazu, the focus shifts to rushing water and tropical forest. In Búzios, the fixed itinerary gives way to choosing your own pace. The twelve days therefore do not become an uninterrupted race between excursions: free time follows the most activity-filled parts of the journey.
